title: 운동 같이 하자고 제안하기: 제가 준비할 테니까 같이 해요!
objective: Invite someone to exercise and use -을 테니까.
summary: Two coworkers plan to play badminton together.
setting: Office break room after lunch. 지훈 invites his coworker 마크 to play badminton after work.

task.title: Invite and plan together
task.line: Use the dialogue and the expressions above to choose, fill in, arrange, or answer in Korean.

words.meaning: Do you want to ... together? (friendly invitation)
words.exampleMeaning: Do you want to go hiking together this weekend?

words.meaning: I will do ..., so (you do / don't do ...)
words.example: 제가 자리를 맡아 놓을 테니까 천천히 오세요.
words.exampleMeaning: I'll save us a spot, so take your time.

words.example: 주말에는 사람이 많을 테니까 평일에 가요.
words.exampleMeaning: It'll probably be crowded on the weekend, so let's go on a weekday.

words.meaning: to play (a sport hit with a racket or paddle)
words.exampleMeaning: I play table tennis with coworkers at lunchtime.
You have to wear sneakers inside the gym.
I swim three times a week.

words.meaning: Just come, you don't need to bring anything
words.example: 필요한 건 다 있으니까 몸만 오세요.
words.exampleMeaning: We have everything we need, so just come.

dialogue.meaning: Mark, do you work out these days?

dialogue.korean: 아니요, 하고 싶은데 혼자 하니까 자꾸 안 하게 돼요.
dialogue.meaning: No. I want to, but doing it alone, I keep skipping it.

dialogue.korean: 그럼 저랑 같이 배드민턴 칠래요? 회사 근처 체육관에서 일주일에 두 번 쳐요.
dialogue.meaning: Then do you want to play badminton with me? I play twice a week at a gym near the office.
Sounds good. But I don't have a racket.

dialogue.korean: 제가 라켓을 하나 더 가져갈 테니까 몸만 오세요.
dialogue.meaning: I'll bring an extra racket, so just bring yourself.

dialogue.korean: 운동 끝나면 배고플 테니까 저녁은 제가 살게요.
dialogue.meaning: We'll probably be hungry after we finish, so dinner is on me.

dialogue.korean: 좋아요. 그럼 목요일 일곱 시에 체육관 앞에서 만나요.
dialogue.meaning: Great. Then let's meet in front of the gym on Thursday at seven.

exercises: Choose the right form: 제가 공을 (가져갈 테니까 / 가져갔으니까) 물만 가져오세요.
Fill in the blank with -을 테니까 (많다): 저녁에는 수영장에 사람이 ____ 아침에 가요.
Put the words in order to make an invitation: 탁구를 / 칠래요? / 점심시간에 / 같이
Answer in Korean. Your friend says 「저는 운동화가 없어요.」 Tell them you will lend yours (빌려주다), so they can just come.
Answer in Korean from the dialogue: 지훈 씨와 마크 씨는 언제, 어디에서 만나요?
answers: 점심시간에 같이 탁구를 칠래요? (점심시간에 탁구를 같이 칠래요? / 같이 점심시간에 탁구를 칠래요?)
제가 운동화를 빌려줄 테니까 몸만 오세요. (제 운동화를 빌려줄 테니까 몸만 오세요.)
목요일 일곱 시에 체육관 앞에서 만나요.
